results.title: A Little Gray Wolf Will Come
results.overview: On the eve of the war in Ukraine, a Russian journalist from pro-Kremlin TV channel brings her rebellious and Westernized teenage daughter on a journey through Putin’s Russia.

results.title: Divorce Me
results.overview: A strained relationship between a married couple ends in divorce, but the husband faces a severe financial crisis that compels him to seek help from his ex-wife to save him from prison. Together, they embark on a journey full of challenges and funny situations, during which they discover their true feelings for each other.

results.title: Fatal Ties
results.overview: Nicole has just had the night of her life with the guy of her dreams, everything is perfect. Until Jon proposes and Nicole accepts. After having a change of heart about the newly found whirlwind romance, Jon is hell bent on showing Nicole that 'til Death do us part' is more than words.

results.title: Broken Wings
results.overview: The untold story of bird poaching in Southeast Asia. Forests are being cleared on a massive scale, and more than a thousand bird species are threatened with extinction. Almost no one knows about it.

results.title: Long Away
results.overview: The film opens twenty-five years into the future on Victoria and her partner, Leah, discussing the risks and concerns for what Victoria is about to do: travel into her own past. Victoria's father passed away at a young age and she never got to really know him. Being a trans woman, Victoria is haunted by the question of if her father would accept her for who she truly is. She travels back in time to a comic store where her father works and gets the chance to meet him while being careful to not share who she is for risk of upsetting the timeline.

results.title: Clean Slate
results.overview: Helen and Robert share a quiet evening, exchanging stories of the past, but when a simple request disrupts their routine, Robert realizes someone is quietly watching him, someone beyond the threshold.

results.title: Blue Ball
results.overview: In the heart of a ship bound for the new world, Patience faces the consequences of her actions, until the Captain's punishment is suddenly interrupted.

results.title: anniversary_6
results.overview: A dysfunctional anniversary date leads a man to an extreme method to try to win his boyfriend's heart back.

results.title: In Warm Waters
results.original_title: Früher war das Meer noch wärmer
results.overview: In search of their shared memories, a young woman must venture beneath the surface to find new hope with her mother.

results.title: To New Beginnings
results.overview: It's New Year's Eve. Friends Nomi, Jens, Charlotte and Kris and their children meet for a festive dinner as is tradition. But this year something is different from usual, because as a joker this year, Nomi's new boyfriend Finn also arrives.

results.title: Summer Souvenir
results.overview: Spontaneous and full of life, Katja enjoys a brash surfing holiday where she discovers love and sexuality, until she ends up in an unexpected situation while paragliding and a dark shadow falls over her summer.

results.title: A Desert
results.overview: A photographer’s road trip takes a dark turn when he befriends a reckless couple, plunging him into a nightmarish neo-noir spiral of unpredictable horror.

results.title: The Bread Season
results.overview: “The Bread Season” takes place today in the Kurdish city of Amed (Diyarbakir), located within present day eastern Turkey. Working class life is a daily struggle that places enormous pressure on the family and familiar relationships. This film follows the experiences of one such family and its members: Mahmoud, the father; Fatma, the mother; and Azad, their son, as they survive and dream of different ways of living while stuck in the open hostility of their family relationship.

results.title: Lorong Kost
results.overview: On the second day of Eid, Koko's boarding house was still occupied by several residents who did not go home for the holidays, and on that day, Tika became a new resident. Unfortunately, on that same day, a murder tragedy occurred, causing all the residents to suddenly become witnesses and be prohibited from leaving! During the investigation, what happened instead was the haunting of the spirit of the murdered resident, which sparked suspicion among the boarding house occupants.

results.title: Lina
results.overview: The film tells about people who are in creative and life crises. The main character wants to make a movie. She meets actors, enters into relationships with them, talks about creativity and life. But something does not give her peace, and strange things begin to happen in her apartment.

results.title: Boy Friends
results.overview: As seen through the raw digital lens of a Canon XL2, Boy Friends exposes four young men's desperate yearnings for connection and meaning within the loud city of Los Angeles.

results.title: The 90s: The Pagode Explosion
results.overview: A documentary that revisits the golden age of pagode, celebrating the musical genre that defined a generation and dominated parties, TV shows, and radio stations across Brazil. Through archival footage and testimonials from artists and behind-the-scenes figures, the film explores the phenomenon's roots, its meteoric rise, and the legacy that still resonates in today's music. In a nostalgic musical showcase featuring major names from the genre, timeless hits are reimagined, paying tribute to pagode's impact on Brazilian culture.

results.title: Solidarity
results.overview: Solidarity is an irresistible feeling we celebrate, but in fact, it is mostly contradictory. This documentary delves into the phenomenon itself and uncovers the universal power of human rights.
